aesthetic: Terminal Manuscript — Swiss grid discipline applied to a phosphor-lit interrogation of print culture vs. machine intelligence, where the warmth of paper fights the cold glow of the terminal
chromaticArc: Opens on warm paper (#F8F5F0) for the course introduction, pulses with phosphor teal accents through the six-lens dialectical sequence, burns to cautionary amber on the critical and prophetic slides, hits two ink-black (#1A1A18) section dividers at the major structural breaks (slides 13 and 27), then returns to warm cream for the closing — the deck's luminance arc mirrors a terminal session that begins and ends in daylight
gridStrategy: Accent bars traverse the full 60-column field across the deck — beginning at col:2 on slide 1 and advancing in a staggered, non-linear sequence to col:54 by slide 38 — while title zones alternate between four extreme anchors (full-bleed, bottom-weighted, right-pushed, left-narrow) in a cycle that never repeats within any five consecutive slides, and body columns oscillate between span:14 (narrow) and span:48 (near-full) to sustain perpetual compositional surprise

fontStrategy.secondarySlides: Georgia appears on the 8–10 philosophical and reflective slides — the Hegelian underpinning, Geist case study, open-source dialectic — where its serif warmth introduces a ghost of humanist uncertainty against Futura's cold declarations; Courier New surfaces on data-heavy slides, assessment tables, and any slide where the machine's own voice is being quoted or interrogated

accentStrategy: Every slide carries exactly one coloured accent element — a vertical or horizontal bar (span 2–6, deployed at a unique column position), a filled block, or a ruled line — cycling through phosphor teal on structural slides, cautionary amber on critical or prophetic slides, and institutional blue on assessment and course-architecture slides, so that reading the deck's thumbnails in sequence reveals the bar migrating like a typographic pulse across the grid
